children.game_version: Partner mirror game where children match the Holy Trinity finger gesture and arm sways.

avoid: Single-leg weight shifts without balance support
seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm rhythms and Holy Trinity three-finger gesture while seated, gently swaying the waist left and right.
seniors.standing_version: Perform paired hand gestures and waist swings while keeping both feet planted for stability.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a comfortable arm range and gentle tempo.

learning_units.description: Holy Trinity hand gesture and arm rhythm execution in pairs

social_formats.description: Danced by women in pairs with audience vocal and clapping interaction

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms move to the beat; three fingers joined together representing the Holy Trinity.
movement_profile.footwork: Identical steps to the Varasos handkerchief and spoon dance.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Waist swings allowed to the left and right.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Upright posture with weight shifts; jumps not described in sources.
movement_profile.posture: Weight emphasis held on one leg with fluid waist swings left and right.

signature_moves.description: Joining three fingers together while moving arms to the beat.
signature_moves.name: Holy Trinity gesture

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Rhythmic and expressive through upper body.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid losing the three-finger gesture or breaking the paired spatial arrangement.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic arm beat reinforced by hand-clapping
music_profile.sound_description: Communal vocal singing accompanied by rhythmic audience hand-clapping and vocal calls.

basic_steps: Step into paired formation facing partner
Shift weight onto one primary leg
Join three fingers together on each hand to represent the Holy Trinity
Swing waist gently left and right while expressing beat through hands and arms
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly basic steps matching the Varasos spoon dance, focusing on arm balance and hand gesture precision.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic beat expressed through arm movements, supported by hand-clapping and community singing.
